newReferralOutDescription: Refer the patient onward (e.g. back to a primary health care facility). The referral is sent to the receiving facility.
referralOutFailed: Could not create the referral out
startVisitFirstSubtitle: The referral response is recorded during the patient’s visit. Start a visit when the patient arrives.
startVisitToReferOut: Start a visit to raise a referral out
startVisitToRespondHint: Start a visit when the patient arrives, then record the referral response
